message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard legend explicitly labels the dark burgundy end as “High” prevalence and the pale yellow end as “Low” prevalence. Among the available options, New York (NY) is shaded dark burgundy (highest prevalence), Delaware (DE) is light orange (intermediate), and North Carolina (NC) is pale yellow (lowest prevalence). The routing criterion requires the highest-prevalence state, which corresponds to NY. The alternative interpretation of selecting the lightest state is refuted by the visible legend labels." , "option_label": "Open New York (NY) prevalence detail for priority follow-up"}
